svg.aria-label: Konecta Secure Container Pipeline defense-in-depth map: source artefacts on the left feed three pre-build gates (Hadolint for dockerfile lint, Checkov for dockerfile IaC misconfig, Gitleaks for source and git-history secrets). Survivors enter the build-and-scan stage where Trivy runs once with vuln, secret, misconfig and license scanners plus a CycloneDX SBOM. Trivy secret findings always hard-fail with no severity dial. Surviving images flow to Cosign keyless signing with SBOM and vulnerability attestations and an SLSA Level 3 in-toto provenance attestation. Finally Skopeo atomically retags the staging digest to version, lane, latest and sha tags in the Konecta Artifact Registry. Animated dashes indicate data flow direction.
svg.text: Eight gates between source and registry · every gate fails closed by default · animated arrows show data flow
Fail-closed behaviour · what happens when a gate triggers

g.text: Gate exits 1 by default · build does not publish · annotation
surfaces in run · setting allow_*_bypass=true downgrades to
::warning:: + exit 0 · bypass is recorded in record-of-approvals.
Trivy secret findings — credentials baked into a layer
always block the build · no allow_*_bypass flag honours them ·
resolve at source by purging from history before retry.
enable_*=false skips the gate entirely (air-gapped / promote-only
flows). allow_*_bypass=true runs the gate but does not enforce ·

svg.text: Audit trail · what KSCP writes back to the run
Eight gates · two hard-fail (Trivy secret, pin-audit at PR time) · six soft with audit-trail bypass · every enable_* / allow_* flag has a default of secure-by-construction.
